name: decomposer
description: Turn sheet music PDFs, scans and screenshots into editable MusicXML and MuseScore files, on your own computer.
long_description: Give Claude the path of a score - a PDF, scanned pages, or a folder of images - and it reads the music into an editable score: MusicXML, and a MuseScore file when MuseScore 4 is installed. Claude checks the page order and resolution first, and compares the result with the source afterwards. The reading is done on your computer by the copista OMR model (KobiMusic); the first use downloads about 125 MB of model weights and a Python environment of about 1 GB. Needs macOS with uv, git and poppler installed. Lyrics are not transcribed.
